description: This Java class 'EcuTableDefinitionHandler' parses ECU Definition XML files to extract table attributes and their scaling information based on specified table names. It provides static methods to retrieve table definitions by processing DOM Documents and Node lists.

classes.name: EcuTableDefinitionHandler
classes.description: Utility class for parsing ECU definition XML files to extract table and scaling attributes based on table name.

methods.name: getTableDefinition
methods.description: Public static method that retrieves a map of table and scaling attributes for a specified table name from the provided XML document and inheritance node list.

methods.name: get2dTableMap
methods.description: Private static helper method that locates the table node with the specified name within the given node, and populates the provided map with attributes from the table and its scaling node.

methods.name: addAttributesAsMap
methods.description: Private static helper method that converts the attributes of a Node into key-value pairs in a map.
